QUOTE: ServerManager::is_explicitly_allowed └─ PermissionManager::is_allowed(allow list) ──match──► approved
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says an allow match leads to "approved" within check_approval, but it never says the allow list only suppresses the approval step rather than granting execution, and it never says the allow list is consulted only from check_approval in a different file.
